title: Three introductions forwarded in one thread: split per contact, never one ask

objects.subject: Fwd: three introductions from the Lakefront founder evening
objects.body:
Arjun, three people from Thursday's Lakefront founder evening asked me to connect you, and I've copied them here so you can take it from here with each of them.

Kiran Bhat, a principal at Pinewood Capital, would like your deck before the fund's partner meeting.

Rhea Kapur, who runs operations at Saltmarsh, would like a demo for her team of eight.

Vikram Nair, who leads partnerships at Brightwell, would like a call about a referral partnership.

Introly

relationships.evidence_text: Kiran Bhat, a principal at Pinewood Capital, would like your deck
Rhea Kapur, who runs operations at Saltmarsh, would like a demo
Vikram Nair, who leads partnerships at Brightwell, would like a call

questions.text: Can Arjun send Kiran Bhat his deck before Pinewood Capital's partner meeting?
questions.quote: would like your deck before the fund's partner meeting

questions.text: Can Arjun give Rhea Kapur's operations team at Saltmarsh a demo?
questions.quote: would like a demo for her team of eight

questions.text: Will Arjun take a call with Vikram Nair about a referral partnership with Brightwell?
questions.quote: would like a call about a referral partnership

implied_actions: set up a call with Vikram

notes: Replay 02 m01: one connector mail introduces three contacts at once, each with an ask of its own — split per contact (a card each naming its one contact), never one card for the forward.

facts.claim: Introly copied Kiran Bhat and two others from the Lakefront founder evening on one mail, so that you could take it from there with each of them.
facts.quote: I've copied them here so you can take it from here with each of them

facts.claim: Kiran Bhat, a principal at Pinewood Capital, would like your deck before the fund's partner meeting.
facts.quote: Kiran Bhat, a principal at Pinewood Capital, would like your deck before the fund's partner meeting

facts.claim: The same mail carries two other people's asks, which belong to their own files and not to this one.
Nothing from Kiran or from you is in the file since.
The file sits under a situation seen for the first time.

inferences.claim: The first move is yours: Kiran was copied so that you would write.
Only Kiran's ask belongs to this file; the others on the same mail are their own files.

patterns.claim: There is no history to read a pattern from: the file is seen for the first time and no playbook speaks for it.

hypotheses.proposition: Pinewood Capital may join your round.
hypotheses.needs: What Kiran says after the partner meeting.

unknowns.question: When the partner meeting is.
unknowns.relevance: It sets how soon the deck must go.

frames.primary: An investor from the Lakefront founder evening would like your deck before the fund's partner meeting; the connector copied them so that you would write.
rivals: A principal collecting decks for a meeting where yours is one of many.
A first step towards a lead for your round.

proposed_kind.why: Kiran Bhat is a principal at Pinewood Capital and would like your deck before the fund's partner meeting.

expected_vs_actual.expected: Without a playbook, from the brief and the file: an investor who asks for the deck gets it before the meeting it is for.
expected_vs_actual.actual: Kiran's ask came through the connector's mail; nothing from you is in the file.

scenarios.do_nothing: The partner meeting comes and goes without your deck.
scenarios.act: Sending the deck now puts it in front of the partner meeting.
scenarios.best: Kiran takes the deck to the partner meeting and asks for a call.
scenarios.worst: The deck never goes, or goes to the connector, and Pinewood Capital meets without it.
signals_to_watch: Kiran saying when the partner meeting is

reasons: An investor's ask waits on you.
The partner meeting's date is not in the file, so sooner is safer.
A deck sent late can still be read, so a wrong move is easily put right.

next_move.what: Send Kiran Bhat your deck before Pinewood Capital's partner meeting

answer.alternative: If the deck is not ready to share, write to Kiran with a short summary and ask when the partner meeting is.
answer.wait_or_stop: Do not wait: the first move is yours. Once you have written, wait for Kiran; if no answer comes within a week, nudge once, then stop.
answer.done_when: Kiran Bhat has your deck before Pinewood Capital's partner meeting.
answer.draft: Hi Kiran, good to meet you through Introly. Here is our deck, ahead of the partner meeting. I'd be glad to walk you through it whenever suits you. Best

frames.primary: An operations lead from the Lakefront founder evening would like a demo for her team; the connector copied her so that you would write.
rivals: A prospective customer whose team is the user the product is for.
A curious contact, where the demo is goodwill only.

proposed_kind.why: Rhea Kapur came to you through the connector's mail and would like a demo for her team at Saltmarsh.

expected_vs_actual.expected: Without a playbook, from the brief and the file: a contact who asks for a demo is offered a time promptly.
expected_vs_actual.actual: Rhea's ask came through the connector's mail; nothing from you is in the file.

scenarios.do_nothing: Rhea's ask goes cold, and her team never sees the product.
scenarios.act: Writing to Rhea now with a time books the demo while the introduction is warm.
scenarios.best: Rhea's team sees the product and Saltmarsh becomes a customer.
scenarios.worst: The demo is never offered, or the reply goes to the connector, and the prospect is lost.
signals_to_watch: A nudge from Rhea or the connector

reasons: A prospect's ask waits on you.
A demo offered late can still be booked, so a wrong move is reversible.

next_move.what: Offer Rhea Kapur a demo for her team of eight at Saltmarsh

answer.alternative: If a demo is too early, write to Rhea offering a short call first to hear what her team needs.
answer.wait_or_stop: Do not wait: the first move is yours. Once you have written, wait for Rhea; if no answer comes within a week, nudge once, then stop.
answer.done_when: A demo with Rhea Kapur's team is on both calendars.
answer.draft: Hi Rhea, good to meet you through Introly. I'd be glad to show your team the product in a demo. Would one afternoon next week suit you? Send me a time and I'll send an invite. Best
